question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Brittle
solution:
The correct answer is "**Durable**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word
 
 
• **Brittle: **hard but liable to break easily.
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **Crumbling: **breaking or falling apart into small fragments, especially as part of a process of deterioration.
 
• **Fragile: **(of an object) easily broken or damaged.
 
• **Durable: **able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage; hard-wearing.
 
• **Frail: **easily damaged or broken; weak.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given options, "**durable**" is the antonym of "brittle".
 
 
• **Example**: *The district magistrate inspected the **durability **__of the bridge before its inauguration.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
 
• **Brittle:**** **कठिन लेकिन आसानी से टूटने के लिए उत्तरदायी।
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **Crumbling:**** **छोटे टुकड़ों में टूटना या गिरना, विशेष रूप से गिरावट की प्रक्रिया के हिस्से के रूप में।
 
• **Fragile:**** **(किसी वस्तु का) आसानी से टूटा या क्षतिग्रस्त।
 
• **Durable:**पहनने, दबाव या क्षति का सामना करने में सक्षम; कठोर पहनावा।
 
• **Frail:**** **आसानी से क्षतिग्रस्त या टूटा हुआ; कमज़ोर।
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given options, "**durable**" is the antonym(विलोम)of "brittle".
